reason: Asserted that the test helper `_console_script` finds prov-convert and prov-compare. test_cli_smoke.py::test_prov_convert_and_compare_end_to_end resolves both names through the same helper and runs them, so it fails whenever a script is missing. With prov-convert moved out of the environment's bin directory it and test_cli_smoke.py::test_prov_convert_jsonld_output_format failed, and with prov-compare moved out only the end-to-end test failed. The maintainer accepted one loss. A missing script now fails with `TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not NoneType`, which does not name the script, where this test said "prov-convert not installed". A misspelt entry-point function in `pyproject.toml` passed this test and failed the end-to-end test.

Asserted only that the `main` functions of `prov.scripts.convert` and `prov.scripts.compare` are callable, and was removed with its two module-level imports of them. A missing or non-callable `main` fails every import and every call of it, so nothing is lost. test_cli_smoke.py::test_prov_convert_and_compare_end_to_end runs both scripts, which resolve those names through the entry points, test_scripts.py::test_convert_parses_explicit_argv_and_leaves_sys_argv_alone calls the convert `main`, and test_scripts.py::test_different_documents_return_1 calls the compare `main`. The verifier planted a rename of each `main` and a convert `main` set to None. Each rename also broke test_scripts.py at collection through its module-level imports, and the non-callable convert `main` failed test_scripts.py::test_convert_parses_explicit_argv_and_leaves_sys_argv_alone. A compare `main` set to None, planted in review, failed 24 tests, among them test_scripts.py::test_different_documents_return_1 and test_cli_smoke.py::test_prov_convert_and_compare_end_to_end. test_cli_smoke.py::test_prov_convert_jsonld_output_format is a second catcher of a renamed convert `main`. The test ran no line of src/prov, so the mutation check could not see it, and the evidence for the removal is the planted faults above.

The installed prov-convert script converts a PROV-JSON file to PROV-XML with exit status 0 and a non-empty output, and the installed prov-compare script then finds the two files equivalent with exit status 0. `docs/reference/prov-convert.md` and `docs/reference/prov-compare.md` document the two commands, and the prov-compare page documents exit status 0 for equivalent documents. It runs the installed scripts as subprocesses, a different entry point from the in-process `main` calls in test_scripts.py. It took over from the removed test_cli_smoke.py::test_entry_point_functions_exist for both scripts, and from the removed test_cli_smoke.py::test_console_scripts_installed. A rename of either `main` and a convert `main` set to None make it fail, and moving prov-convert or prov-compare out of the environment's bin directory makes it fail with a `TypeError` from `subprocess.run` that does not name the script. A misspelt entry-point function in `pyproject.toml` fails it with a clear ImportError.
The installed prov-convert script writes a PROV-JSONLD file from a PROV-JSON file with exit status 0 and a non-empty output. `docs/reference/prov-convert.md` lists jsonld among the output formats.
